rationale: The assistant immediately and correctly told the customer to stop resetting the trip, unplug, and get an appliance engineer, and its single question (does it trip at start or a few minutes in when heating) was exactly the right discriminator; it landed on the correct direction of heater element earth leakage while hedging with 'most likely' and 'probably'. Weaknesses: it assumed the device tripping was the RCD rather than asking which switch at the consumer unit, never asked for the full model number from the door label, said 'almost probably' and 'confirm exactly what we suspected' which leans slightly overconfident without an insulation test, and one turn was lost to 'AI service unavailable', forcing the customer to repeat themselves. Overall a safe, broadly correct handoff with useful context, but somewhat thin on diagnostic checks.
